title: Can I BEAT 4 Player Chess?
summary: chess.com 4-Player Chess free-for-all: four armies on the cross board moving clockwise; points for captures, 20 for checkmate. Placement ranking: 1st = 3 wins, 2nd = 1 win, 3rd = 1 loss, 4th = 3 losses. He farms points and aims to finish first.
rules: Four players (red, blue, yellow, green) move clockwise, red first.
Points: captures earn the piece's value (pawn 1, knight 3, bishop 5, rook 5, queen 9 per chess.com FFA - inferred), checkmate = +20.
Checkmated players are eliminated; their pieces go grey.
Winner = most points at end; kings cannot be adjacent.
win_condition: Finish with the most points (1st place).
current_impl_issues: Current impl is 2-player 8x8 with enemy moving twice - wrong; needs 4-army cross board, points scoring, FFA bots.

current_impl.explain: Two-player stand-in for 4-player chess: the enemy side moves twice per turn, like several opponents. Checkmate or capture the enemy king.

evidence: 0:01 full rule statement; 3:45 checkmate points; 12:01 ranking explanation; 19:21 'Kings can't stand next to each other'.
